study.phenotype_description: After 3 days of treatment, plates were scanned with CCD flatbed scanners (EPSON Perfection V600 Photo, Seiko Epson, Nagano, Japan), and images used to quantify root parameters with FIJI, by using the tool ‘segmented line’ (Schindelin et al., 2012) as described in Ristova and Busch (2017).
